about_the_game:
Dino-Might is a competitive couch co-op fighting game where you control a tiny-armed T-Rex in a prehistoric smackdown. Battle 2-4 players in fast-paced local and online multiplayer matches—only one dino will survive extinction!

Multiplayer Mayhem

Enjoy your last moments in the prehistoric arena with friends or foes! Battle it out in 2-4 player matches, whether you're smackin’ dinos on the couch or throwing down online.

Local Play: Grab some controllers and challenge your crew! (Controllers required.)

Online Play: Face off with friends or rivals using a keyboard or controller.

Entertaining Tiny-Arm Combat

Tiny arms, big impact! Every attack is a leap of faith—jump at the right angle, commit to the strike, and take down your foes. Mistime it, and you’re dino toast!

Simple controls, endless strategy. Bait opponents, chain attacks, or dominate the high ground—how you fight is up to you!

Adorable Dino Customization

Personalize your dino with a variety of colors and accessories. Feeling cowboy cute today? Or how about pierced punk? Well, in Dino-Might, you can change it up each game.  

Exciting Powerful Pickups

Quick, get that fireball before your opponent does! Use an array of game-changing pickups like fireballs, speed boosts, double jumps, and invisibility to gain the upper hand. 


Let Out Your Rawr!

YOU CAN RAWR! Enough said.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: If it's a laptop with no dedicated GPU, CPU should be less than 5 years old.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU recommended
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 650 MB available space

short_description: Dino-Might is a couch co-op fighting game where you control a tiny-armed T-Rex in a prehistoric smackdown! Customize your look, pounce on your opponents, dodge pitfalls, and watch out for the incoming meteor shower in a wild battle for survival. Who will be the last dino standing?
